messages:
natalie: Quick lexicon triage — I opened a meta issue with a short checklist for small copy/glossary fixes and a few migration-guide inconsistencies we should fix before the next release. Can we divvy up owners for fast PRs? https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/123
ben: I'll take SDK snippets + param name harmonization (JS + Python).
elaine: I can handle glossary entries A–F. I'll add preferred-term, deprecated-term mapping, and a one-line rationale.
sam: I can do Console microcopy & tooltips, will drop comments on the UI PR (#4523).
priya: Heads up — a few migration guides still reference `model=redwood-3` which is outdated. I'll open a tiny PR to update those links and the example.
docs-ci-bot: ci: build passed for PR #4523 (docs) :white_check_mark:
natalie: Priority order I propose: 1) migration guide fixes (potentially breaking if left), 2) SDK snippets / param names, 3) glossary cleanup, 4) Console microcopy. Please tag PRs with `docs/small-fix` and add `release-blocker` only for migration fixes. Aim to merge by EOD Thursday.
ben: Got it. Quick question — do we canonicalize on `client.generate()` or `client.text.generate()` for public examples? We standardized recently but a few samples still use the old form.
elaine: Keep `client.generate()` as canonical. I'll run a scan and replace occurrences. Plan to use a quick sed grep to catch the old pattern. Example snippet I'll run locally: `grep -R "client.text.generate" -l | xargs sed -i 's/client.text.generate/client.generate/g'`
sam: :thumbsup: I'll update the Console strings in Crowdin once the PRs merge so translations don't lag.
priya: Opened PR 4539 for migration link & example fixes, assigning @natalie as reviewer.
natalie: Thanks! Can someone QA the SDK snippet changes on mac/linux? Need to confirm param names for `temperature` vs `temp` and ensure samples still run.
ben: I can QA on mac.
sam: I'll take linux.
elaine: I'll run a grep for temperature synonyms and paste the list here when done.
docs-ci-bot: link-check: found 2 broken links in PR #4539 — report: https://ci.internal/reports/4539/links
priya: Fixing those now, will push another commit in a minute.
natalie: Also please add a short entry in the glossary changelog for any term we modify (one-liner rationale). Can we add alias entries for capitalization variants (e.g., "redwood dedicated" -> "Dedicated") so searches won't return mixed-case results?
ben: I'll add alias entries and the changelog note.
sam: One more item — make sure SDK examples that rely on a pinned API version include `version: '2026-03-01'` where required. I'll flag any missing ones in my PR review.
natalie: Perfect. I'll post a short checklist in the meta issue and link PRs there. If docs-ci fails on link-checks ping me directly. Thanks all :raised_hands:
